title: organized utilities and routing

specimens.name: Perforated steel cable-tray segment
specimens.description: Short galvanized or painted tray with a neatly laid multi-core cable bundle retained by uniform clips.

specimens.name: Bundled electrical harness on standardized clamps
specimens.description: Several insulated cables routed in parallel through identical P-clamps on a short mounting strip.

specimens.name: Steel electrical conduit 90-degree sweep
specimens.description: Factory-bent conduit elbow with one threaded union coupling; no junction box.

specimens.name: Die-cast junction box
specimens.description: Rectangular gasketed industrial box with removable lid and two standardized cable glands; no attached cables.

specimens.name: Painted steel pipe 90-degree elbow
specimens.description: Clean industrial elbow with one standardized union coupling; no valve or surrounding pipe network.

specimens.name: Flanged pipe joint
specimens.description: Two short pipe ends with matching circular flanges, gasket edge and identical evenly spaced bolts.

specimens.name: Hydraulic hose segment
specimens.description: Reinforced black hose with factory-crimped ferrule fittings and one molded bend restrictor; no manifold.

specimens.name: Compact solenoid valve manifold block
specimens.description: Small metal block with four standardized fluid ports and two coil housings; no hoses or wires.

global_forbidden: baked cast shadows or contact shadows
glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX

era_contract.character: deliberately routed and supported utilities with standardized connectors/fittings and hydraulic/electrical service modules
